AVIATION — TERMLY EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Input Cable Tester

2. When learning Aircraft Basic Maintenance, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Basic Maintenance.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Basic Maintenance.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Basic Maintenance.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Basic Maintenance.

3. When learning Introduction to Simulated Flying, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Simulated Flying.

   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Simulated Flying.

   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Systems.

   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Safety.

8. When learning Aviation Security, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Aviation Security.

   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aviation Security.

9. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Overload every socket

10. When learning Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.

13. When learning Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.

   D. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.

14. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

15. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. Keyboard
   C. Speaker
   D. CPU

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Aviation Entrepreneurship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
